name: B3000 - Email Control
description: Intent: Block-tier hard enforcement on Email send / attachment_send / sent_email at sensitivity floor [3,4] — shuts down sensitive content from leaving via outbound mail to personal or non-vetted external recipients. Exclusions: excludes recipients in Users_Authorized_Internal_User_Suffixes_[ends_with] and Users_Authorized_External_Email_Suffixes_[ends_with]; ships disabled — enable after both Authorized email lists are populated and W3000 reviews are clean. Requirements: WIP — pending analyst testing.
